description: This Dart source file provides a configuration class for initializing and accessing a Supabase client within a Flutter application. It reads environment variables for configuration, validates the URL, and initializes the Supabase client.

classes.name: SupabaseConfig
classes.description: A class that manages the initialization and retrieval of the Supabase client, including environment variable validation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the Supabase client using environment variables, performing validation on the URL and keys, and handling errors.

methods.name: client
methods.description: Provides access to the initialized Supabase client instance.

methods.name: effectiveSupabaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used for Supabase after initialization, or an empty string if not yet initialized.
